budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Rio de Janeiro? Hotel Prices for Rio de Janeiro, Brazil | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: Budget Your Trip hotel snippet reports a 1-star hotel average of $81 for one night (median $62; 293 samples), in USD before taxes and from Kayak.
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Current snippet retrieval; one-night city 1-star average
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Exact-city 1-star numeric average and separate exact-city double-occupancy wording were both found; retained as a proxy, not direct ground truth.

directCandidates.evidenceText: Google Hotels snippet identifies Petit Rio Hotel as 1-star and shows $68 total/per-night with taxes and fees; it does not explicitly state two adults and one room.
directCandidates.searchQuery: Rio de Janeiro Brazil Google Hotels 1-star hotel two adults one room one night price taxes
directCandidates.reason: Exact class, named property, numeric nightly total, and tax treatment are present, but occupancy is not explicit.
